newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby UNION-Brumbies name unchanged side to face New South Wales.
newsitem.headline: Rugby UNION-Brumbies name unchanged side to face New South Wales.

text.p: The ACT Brumbies have named an unchanged side for the crucial Super 12 clash with New South Wales at Bruce Stadium on Saturday.
Third-placed ACT need to win to cement their place in the top four in the chase for a semifinal berth in the southern hemisphere provincial competition.
New South Wales, who lost to Queensland on Saturday in a spiteful encounter, must win to have any realistic chance of reaching the last four.

ACT Brumbies - Stephen Larkham, Mitch Hardy, James Holbeck, Pat Howard, Joe Roff, David Knox, George Gregan, Troy Coker, Brett Robinson (captain), Owen Finegan, David Giffin, John Langford, Ewan McKenzie, Marco Caputo, Patricio Noriega.
Reserves - Liam O'Connor, Geoff Logan, Ipolito Fenukitau, Timote Tavalea, Justin Harrison, Dean Zammit.
